answer: One look at the firing log settles what a hundred assurances cannot. The tundra shows someone vouched, the wharf shows someone paid, the falcon shows someone waited — and farms can only forge the first two. Payment is taken at the door, not at the prize table: the farm hands over 66309 POA while one agent hands over 93. No story crosses this threshold, only each set brooch is a measured gem yield plus a guild signature, which is what Bead polisher set brooch seal faceted in the cutting loft requires. Harvest comes for honest agents; the farm finds the field fenced before it arrives.
